lines.zh: 壳贴着沙底滑，我慢慢靠近你。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the sand as I slide toward you.

lines.zh: 潮水推我一步，我自己再爬一步。
lines.en: The tide pushes me one step; I crawl another.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里挪动，贝壳一张一合。
lines.en: I shift through the shallows, my shell opening and closing.

lines.zh: 水草让开，我沿着礁石边挪过去。
lines.en: The kelp parts; I creep along the reef's edge.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，可我从不停下。
lines.en: I crawl slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 浪退了，我顺着湿沙往前蹭。
lines.en: The wave pulls back; I scrape forward over wet sand.

lines.zh: 我的壳摩擦石头，发出咯吱声。
lines.en: My shell grinds against stone with a creak.

lines.zh: 我绕过珊瑚，朝你那边挪。
lines.en: I round the coral and shuffle toward your side.

lines.zh: 水底的影子在动，那是我。
lines.en: The shadow on the seabed moves; that shadow is me.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过贝壳碎片。
lines.en: I crunch over shell shards, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我就在水边等。
lines.en: You back onto land; I wait at the waterline.

lines.zh: 我挪过整片浅滩，只为你。
lines.en: I cross the whole shoal, and only for you.

lines.zh: 我伏在水底，壳缝里冒着气泡。
lines.en: I lie on the bottom, bubbles leaking from my shell seam.

lines.zh: 水流过鳃，我一动不动。
lines.en: Water runs through my gills; I do not move at all.

lines.zh: 沙粒落在我壳上，我懒得抖。
lines.en: Sand settles on my shell; I cannot be bothered to shake it.

lines.zh: 我半张着壳，等水里的味道。
lines.en: I hold my shell half open, tasting the water.

lines.zh: 光透过水面，在我壳上晃动。
lines.en: Light through the water wavers across my shell.

lines.zh: 我沉在礁石缝里，慢慢磨牙。
lines.en: I sink into a reef crevice and grind my teeth slowly.

lines.zh: 潮声很闷，我在下面听着。
lines.en: The tide sounds muffled; I listen from below.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼擦过我的壳边。
lines.en: A small fish brushes past the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 我不追，也不躲，只是待着。
lines.en: I neither chase nor hide; I merely stay.

lines.zh: 水草缠上我的壳，我随它去。
lines.en: Kelp tangles on my shell, and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我抬起壳口，正对着你的脸。
lines.en: I lift my shell mouth level with your face.

lines.zh: 壳缘对着你，缝里慢慢渗水。
lines.en: My shell rim faces you, water seeping through the seam.

lines.zh: 我从水底仰起半个壳看你。
lines.en: I tilt half my shell up from the bottom to watch you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我让壳停住不动。
lines.en: You stand on shore; I hold my shell perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我把壳口转向声音来的地方。
lines.en: I turn my shell mouth toward the sound.

lines.zh: 你在水里走，我跟着你的脚看。
lines.en: You wade across, and I follow your feet with my shell.

lines.zh: 我的壳纹里映着你的影子。
lines.en: Your shadow sits in the ridges of my shell.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，贝壳本来就没有眼。
lines.en: I do not blink; a shell has no eyes to blink.

lines.zh: 你俯身看我，我闻到了你的呼吸。
lines.en: You lean down; I catch your breath through the water.

lines.zh: 壳缝张开一线，我在里面看你。
lines.en: My seam opens a fraction, and I watch from inside.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，疼得我缩紧。
lines.en: A crack runs through my shell; I clench with pain.

lines.zh: 你打在我壳上，手该麻了。
lines.en: You struck my shell; your hand must be numb.

lines.zh: 壳上这道痕，我认得出你。
lines.en: I will know that mark on my shell, and I will know you.

lines.zh: 我的壳从没这么响过。
lines.en: My shell has never rung like that.

lines.zh: 红的散开，是我的血，不是鱼的。
lines.en: Red blooms in the water: my blood, not a fish's.

lines.zh: 我退半步，牙还咬着。
lines.en: I give half a step, my teeth still locked.

lines.zh: 别以为裂了缝我就软了。
lines.en: Do not think a cracked seam makes me soft.

lines.zh: 疼，可我更生气了。
lines.en: It hurts, and I am angrier for it.

lines.zh: 你找到了壳的薄弱处。
lines.en: You found the weak point of my shell.

lines.zh: 我沉到沙里，再把自己顶起来。
lines.en: I sink into the sand, then slowly lever myself up.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我的壳连缝都没开。
lines.en: You hold out food; my shell does not even crack open.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的东西，我只咬你。
lines.en: I do not want your hand's offering; I want you.

lines.zh: 那点味道引不动我，水里的更香。
lines.en: That smell will not move me; the water carries better.

lines.zh: 你把鱼丢下来，我当它是石头。
lines.en: You toss me a fish; I take it for a stone.

lines.zh: 我绕过诱饵，径直朝你爬。
lines.en: I crawl around the bait and come straight at you.

lines.zh: 食物？我的牙只认活物。
lines.en: Food? My teeth only know living things.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃手里的东西，我没停。
lines.en: You wave that thing about; I do not slow down.

lines.zh: 别拿面包试探一只贝壳。
lines.en: Do not test a shell with bread.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，可我要的不是它。
lines.en: I smell it, but it is not what I want.

lines.zh: 诱饵落在沙上，我压了过去。
lines.en: The bait lands on sand; I crawl right over it.

lines.zh: 你用膝盖顶我的壳，壳没动。
lines.en: You knee my shell; the shell does not budge.

lines.zh: 我被撞了一下，只偏了半寸。
lines.en: I take a hit and shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 别推，我比看上去沉得多。
lines.en: Do not shove; I am far heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 壳撞壳，声音在水下闷响。
lines.en: Shell meets shell with a muffled thud underwater.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳背，我照样往前。
lines.en: You step on my back; I keep going forward.

lines.zh: 我顶回去，水被我挤开。
lines.en: I shove back, and the water gives way.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我壳缝进了沙。
lines.en: That knock wedged sand into my shell seam.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没退。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us backs off.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，你的靴子软。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your boot is soft.

lines.zh: 你挡在路上，我直接碾过去。
lines.en: You block the way; I grind straight through.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩只有我一只壳。
lines.en: I am the only shell on this shoal.

lines.zh: 我不找伴，壳里只住我一个。
lines.en: I seek no mate; only I live in this shell.

lines.zh: 另一只贝壳早被浪冲走了。
lines.en: The other shell was carried off by the tide long ago.

lines.zh: 我独自磨着壳缘过日子。
lines.en: I spend my days grinding the rim of my shell alone.

lines.zh: 潮水带来很多声音，没有同类。
lines.en: The tide brings many sounds, none of my own kind.

lines.zh: 我这样的壳，一只就够沉了。
lines.en: One shell like mine is weight enough for any water.

lines.zh: 配对？我先咬一口再说。
lines.en: Pairing? Let me bite first and discuss it after.

lines.zh: 沙底太宽，我只认得自己的痕。
lines.en: The seabed is wide; I know only my own trail.

lines.zh: 我不叫，壳里没有第二道回声。
lines.en: I do not call; no second echo lives in my shell.

lines.zh: 两只壳相遇，只会互相磨。
lines.en: Two shells meeting would only grind each other down.

lines.zh: 我什么都不捡，也留不下什么。
lines.en: I pick up nothing and leave nothing behind.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沉下去，我不碰。
lines.en: What you drop sinks; I do not touch it.

lines.zh: 沙子进了壳缝，那不算收获。
lines.en: Sand gets into my seam; that is no prize.

lines.zh: 我死后什么也不掉，你白等。
lines.en: When I die I drop nothing, so you wait for nothing.

lines.zh: 我压过一枚铁粒，它陷进泥里。
lines.en: I crawl over an iron nugget and press it into the mud.

lines.zh: 壳里的东西？只有水和沙。
lines.en: What is inside my shell? Only water and sand.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，海底已经够满了。
lines.en: I collect nothing; the seabed is full enough.

lines.zh: 你丢的骨头，我踢到一边。
lines.en: I kick your dropped bone aside.

lines.zh: 拾取对我没意义，我只会咬。
lines.en: Picking things up means nothing to me; I only bite.

lines.zh: 我的壳就是全部家当。
lines.en: My shell is my entire estate.

lines.zh: 水一动，我的壳口就转了过去。
lines.en: The water stirs, and my shell mouth turns.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的暖意。
lines.en: I taste the warmth coming off your body.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面上晃，我记住了。
lines.en: Something sways above the surface, and I mark it.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，声音传到我壳里。
lines.en: You step into the shallows, and the sound reaches my shell.

lines.zh: 我不急，先让水替我量距离。
lines.en: I do not rush; I let the water measure the distance.

lines.zh: 壳缝张开一条线，我盯住你。
lines.en: My seam opens a hair, and I fix on you.

lines.zh: 目标就在那儿，逆着光。
lines.en: The target is right there, backlit.

lines.zh: 我醒了，从沙里抬起半个壳。
lines.en: I wake and lift half my shell out of the sand.

lines.zh: 你身上的动静比鱼大得多。
lines.en: You make far more disturbance than any fish.

lines.zh: 水流告诉我：往左，再往前。
lines.en: The current tells me: left, then forward.

lines.zh: 我认准了，就不打算换。
lines.en: Once I have chosen, I do not intend to change.

lines.zh: 那道影子落进水里，归我了。
lines.en: That shadow has fallen into the water, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 我的壳沉下去，怒气浮上来。
lines.en: My shell sinks, and my temper rises.

lines.zh: 追与不追，从来不是问题。
lines.en: Whether to chase was never a question.

lines.zh: 你在礁石上，我在礁石下。
lines.en: You are on the reef; I am beneath it.

lines.zh: 水波一乱，我就知道是你。
lines.en: The ripples break; I know it is you.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底走，一直对着你。
lines.en: I skim along the bottom, always facing you.

lines.zh: 你往哪退，我的壳就朝哪转。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, my shell turns with you.

lines.zh: 我不喊，水声替我说完了。
lines.en: I do not shout; the water says it all.

lines.zh: 一圈，两圈，我把你围在礁石边。
lines.en: One circle, two, and I pen you against the reef.

lines.zh: 我的牙在里面磨，你听得见。
lines.en: My teeth grind inside, and you can hear it.

lines.zh: 别指望我眨眼，我没有眼皮。
lines.en: Do not wait for me to blink; I have no lids.

lines.zh: 距离在缩，一寸一寸地缩。
lines.en: The gap closes, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你退到石头上，我停在水的边缘。
lines.en: You climb onto rock; I halt at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我把水搅浑，让你看不清我。
lines.en: I mud the water so you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我的壳在水下像一块石头。
lines.en: Underwater, my shell looks like a stone.

lines.zh: 你数着心跳，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: You count heartbeats; I count your footsteps.

lines.zh: 这条路我来回碾过很多次。
lines.en: I have ground back and forth along this path many times.

lines.zh: 我慢慢逼近，浪替我打拍子。
lines.en: I close in slowly, and the surf keeps time for me.

lines.zh: 你已经在我咬得到的范围里。
lines.en: You are already within the range of my bite.

lines.zh: 我的壳缘抵着沙，慢慢挪。
lines.en: My shell rim pushes the sand as I creep.

lines.zh: 你往岸上退，岸上没水。
lines.en: You back toward shore; there is no water there.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下方，抬头看你。
lines.en: I am below your feet, looking up.

lines.zh: 气泡一串串，是我在呼吸。
lines.en: The bubbles are my breathing.

lines.zh: 你不用找出口，我堵住了。
lines.en: No need to look for an exit; I blocked it.

lines.zh: 我咬不到的地方，我就等。
lines.en: Where I cannot bite, I wait.

lines.zh: 壳口合上，你的小腿在里面。
lines.en: My shell mouth closes with your calf inside.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，水一下变红。
lines.en: I bite down, and the water turns red.

lines.zh: 这一口，连礁石都想啃。
lines.en: This bite could chew through reef rock.

lines.zh: 我的牙不快，可它不松。
lines.en: My teeth are not quick, but they do not let go.

lines.zh: 你被拽进水里，脚下一滑。
lines.en: You are dragged into the water, your footing lost.

lines.zh: 壳缘刮过，留下湿淋淋的痕。
lines.en: My shell rim scrapes by and leaves a wet streak.

lines.zh: 我压住你的腿，像压住一块肉。
lines.en: I pin your leg like a cut of meat.

lines.zh: 咬合的声音比浪还响。
lines.en: The snap is louder than the surf.

lines.zh: 你打我，我照样嚼。
lines.en: You hit me, and I keep chewing.

lines.zh: 这一下够你记住这片浅滩。
lines.en: That one will make you remember this shoal.

lines.zh: 我的咬合力是为贝壳长的。
lines.en: My bite was grown for cracking shells.

lines.zh: 血味散开，我咬得更紧。
lines.en: The blood spreads, and I bite down harder.

lines.zh: 你抽回腿，壳上留了齿印。
lines.en: You pull your leg free, leaving tooth marks on my shell.

lines.zh: 我一口一口，把你往深处拖。
lines.en: Bite by bite, I drag you toward the deep.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞上你的膝弯。
lines.en: My shell slams into the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 你在水里站不稳，正好。
lines.en: You cannot stand in the water. Good.

lines.zh: 这一咬，连沙一起吞了。
lines.en: This bite takes the sand along with you.

lines.zh: 壳口里的牙一排排合拢。
lines.en: Rows of teeth close inside my shell.

lines.zh: 你被顶翻，脸朝下。
lines.en: I flip you face down.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，你越挣越紧。
lines.en: I hold on; the more you pull, the tighter.

lines.zh: 沙底翻起一团浑水，我出来了。
lines.en: The sand heaves muddy water, and I emerge.

lines.zh: 我从礁石缝里挤出壳来。
lines.en: I squeeze my shell out of a reef crack.

lines.zh: 潮水把我送上了这片浅滩。
lines.en: The tide delivered me onto this shoal.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的，通常活不久。
lines.en: Whoever sees me first rarely lasts long.

lines.zh: 我的壳还带着深水的凉。
lines.en: My shell still carries the cold of deep water.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I drop in and hammer out a crater.

lines.zh: 这片水域换了主人。
lines.en: This stretch of water has a new owner.

lines.zh: 浪把我推上来，我顺势爬开。
lines.en: The wave shoves me up, and I crawl off with it.

lines.zh: 我从暗处张开壳，等第一个脚步。
lines.en: I open my shell in the dark, waiting for the first footstep.

lines.zh: 刚醒的我很饿。
lines.en: I wake up hungry.

lines.zh: 水底的泥沙还没落定，我已就位。
lines.en: The silt has not settled and I am already in place.

lines.zh: 我来得不响，可水里都知道。
lines.en: I arrive quietly, but the water knows.

lines.zh: 火在水里也烫，我的壳被烤白了。
lines.en: Fire burns even underwater; my shell is scorched white.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔进浅水，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I fall from a height into the shallows and crack my shell on stone.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这一口气没接上。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet this breath would not come.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，把我从水底掀了起来。
lines.en: A blast throws me up off the seabed.

lines.zh: 一支箭从岸上射来，卡进我的壳缝。
lines.en: An arrow from the shore lodges in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进壳里，我的牙发麻。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into my shell and numbs my teeth.

lines.zh: 我太久没咬到活物，壳都轻了。
lines.en: I have not bitten anything living for too long; my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷劈在水面，我整个人都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and numbs me through.

lines.zh: 水没了，下面空得让我张不开壳。
lines.en: The water is gone, and the emptiness below keeps my shell shut.
